dialogues.speaker: Tlilhua
dialogues.text: As long as you believe, you'll make it a reality one day.

dialogues.speaker: Tlilhua
dialogues.text: ...Of course, it all stems from whether the person who bestowed the blessing is reliable.

dialogues.speaker: Tlilhua
dialogues.text: Generally, when people buy new weapons, they'd ask a well-respected friend from the Masters of the Night-Wind to help draw something on it.

dialogues.speaker: Tlilhua
dialogues.text: But as you can see, I'm a wrestler. What kind of weapon could a wrestler even use?

dialogues.speaker: Tlilhua
dialogues.text: So I mostly just buy protective equipment. And it's always reassuring when you're wearing something with a beautiful pattern on it!
